The load forecaster predicts changes from an anchor value instead of the demand level to provide a more accurate and dynamic representation of expected demand fluctuations. This approach allows the model to account for variations and trends over time, rather than relying solely on a static baseline. By using an anchor value, the forecaster can better capture the nuances of demand patterns, such as seasonal variations, daily cycles, and unexpected events. This method enhances the reliability and precision of the forecast, ensuring that it remains adaptable to real-time conditions and changes in the system [unverified citation removed].
